title: UE initiated combined detach procedure completion

entities.name: UE initiated combined detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE-initiated detach from network, handling both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate detach procedure.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept detach request when Detach type IE does not indicate 'switch off'.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: Information element indicating type of detach, including 'switch off' and combined EPS/IMSI detach.

entities.name: T3421
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receiving DETACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered after combined EPS/IMSI detach.

entities.name: MM-NULL
entities.description: MM state entered after combined EPS/IMSI detach.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered for non-EPS services after detach.

entities.name: Detach type not 'switch off'
entities.description: Condition where Detach type IE does not indicate 'switch off', triggering DETACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: UE marked as inactive
entities.description: UE is marked as inactive in network for EPS and non-EPS services after detach.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivated
entities.description: EPS bearer contexts are deactivated locally without peer-to-peer signaling after combined EPS/IMSI detach.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending DETACH REQUEST message.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
DETACH ACCEPT message is sent only if Detach type IE does not indicate 'switch off'.
Procedure establishes deactivation of EPS bearer contexts locally.
Procedure establishes UE marked as inactive in network.
Procedure establishes EMM-REGISTERED state for non-EPS services.
Receiving DETACH ACCEPT message stops timer T3421.
